issues.entry: sy044 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针
issues.problem: Meaning line 'wears down any task' was unidiomatic English and blurred into sy014 世上无难事，只怕有心人 (determination)
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'keep grinding away patiently and even the hardest job gets done', stressing long patient persistence

issues.problem: Meaning line described a type of visitor; the saying is normally said by the visitor about their own visit (我今天是无事不登三宝殿)
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'I only come calling when there is a favour to ask'

issues.problem: Meaning line covered only people getting acquainted; the saying is just as often about tasks and places becoming familiar
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'awkward the first time, at ease the second: familiarity comes fast'

issues.problem: Tag 'quantity' did not fit a saying about teamwork
